factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025 table (page 15): Net profit 2025 EUR 69.9 million vs 2024 EUR 193.7 million; Profit attributable to parent 2025 EUR 70.6 million vs 2024 EUR 191.3 million.

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share decreased to EUR 3.43 from EUR 9.36.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025 table (page 15): EPS 2025 EUR 3.43 vs 2024 EUR 9.36.

factual_claims.claim: Management attributes the lower net profit mainly to one-off effects from the initial consolidation of Tallink in 2024, including a EUR 93.7 million bargain-purchase gain; the 2025 results included no comparable gain.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report (page 15): 'The decrease in net profit compared to the previous year is mainly attributable to one-off effects related to the initial consolidation of Tallink Group recognised in 2024.' Note 9.2: Tallink acquisition included a bargain-purchase gain of EUR 93.7 million in 2024; 2025 had no such gain.

factual_claims.claim: The main driver of revenue and EBITDA growth was Tallink Grupp, which was consolidated for the full twelve months in 2025 compared with only five months in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report (page 13): 'From the third quarter onwards, Tallink's line-by-line consolidated results have significantly impacted the Infortar Group’s financial results.' Note 5: Tallink consolidation started in August 2024 (5 months) and was full-year in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Maritime transport revenue increased to EUR 761.7 million from EUR 316.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 12.2: Maritime transport revenue 2025 EUR 761.7 million vs 2024 EUR 316.8 million.

factual_claims.claim: Tallink carried 5.53 million passengers, down 0.9% year on year, while cargo units declined 19.2% and passenger vehicles 2.2%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report (page 13): 'In the financial year 2025 (1 January–31 December), Tallink carried 5,531,132 passengers, representing a 0.9% decrease year-on-year. The number of cargo units transported decreased by 19.2% to 245,004 while the number of passenger vehicles was down by 2.2% to 760,473.'

factual_claims.claim: Vessel chartering generated EUR 54.9 million and helped reduce seasonal fluctuations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report (page 13): 'In 2025, revenue from vessel chartering helped to balance the seasonal fluctuations in the Group’s sales.' (Specific amount not stated, but context confirms chartering contributed to revenue and seasonality management).

factual_claims.claim: The energy segment remained the largest revenue contributor, with external revenue of EUR 980.2 million compared with EUR 966.2 million, while Elenger’s EBITDA improved by approximately EUR 12 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 12.2: Energy segment external revenue 2025 EUR 980.2 million vs 2024 EUR 966.2 million. Management Report (page 13): 'Elenger’s EBITDA improved by approximately EUR 12 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Energy deliveries remained stable at 18 TWh despite a 9% decline in regional gas consumption and continued price volatility.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Macroeconomic development and its impact (page 18): 'In the 2025 financial year, Elenger delivered a total of 18 TWh LNG cargoes to the Inkoo and Klaipėda terminals (2024: 18 TWh).' Same page: 'Total gas consumption in Finland and the Baltic States decreased by 9% in 2025 compared to the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: Growth also reflected the full-year inclusion of Elenger Polska and the contribution of agricultural businesses.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9.2: Elenger Polska acquired in 2024 and fully consolidated in 2025. Management Report (page 13): Agricultural segment included Estonia Farmid from July 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Infortar acquired 96.6% of Estonia Farmid in July, adding dairy and farming operations that contributed EUR 11.2 million of revenue and EUR 6.4 million of profit attributable to owners during the reporting period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9.2: 'On 7 July 2025, Infortar Agro OÜ acquired a 96.57% ownership interest in OÜ Estonia Farmid... The acquired entity contributed EUR 11.2 million to revenue and EUR 6.4 million to profit attributable to owners during the reporting period.'

factual_claims.claim: It also acquired Oisu Biogaas in November and continued expanding biomethane, solar generation, and energy-storage activities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9.2: 'On 20 November 2025, Infortar’s subsidiary OÜ Infortar Agro acquired a 100% ownership interest in OÜ Oisu Biogaas.' Management Report (page 13) details expansion in biomethane, solar, and storage.

factual_claims.claim: Tallink invested EUR 33 million in vessel maintenance and refurbishment, while Group investment in property, plant, equipment, real estate, and intangible assets totaled approximately EUR 80.1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report (page 13): 'Tallink Grupp investments in the financial year 2025 amounted to EUR 33 million... Group investment in property, plant and equipment, real estate and intangible assets totalled EUR 80.1 million (2024: EUR 44.7 million).'

factual_claims.claim: Financial strength improved.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Supported by subsequent claims S18-S20 showing improvements in cash, liabilities, equity, and ratios.
